services.desc: Buckhead and Downtown Atlanta Duration 30 minutes About This helicopter tour of Atlanta is our most popular tour! We depart Prestige Helicopters and take you to the north side of Buckhead as we make our way to the Governor's Mansion, which is surrounded by some of the largest and most beautiful homes in Atlanta. From there we will take you to Midtown over Atlantic Station to Georgia Tech and The Georgia Aquarium. Then we take a leisurely pass over Centennial Olympic Park, CNN and The Georgia Dome before visiting Turner Field and The State Capitol. services.name: Chattahoochee River and Buckhead
services.desc: Buckhead and Downtown Atlanta Duration 20 minutes About One of the things that makes Atlanta unique is it's good balance of urban Architecture and Naturalistic Landscapes. This tour combines a bit of both. Start by taking a lap around the Buckhead skyline, buzzing the tops of the skyscrapers. Then head over to the Chattahoochee River and check out all of the historic estates that line the the banks of the river. Next enjoy the view from the air over the Vinings and Cumberland Overlook areas. Finally, check out Suntrust Park, the new home of The Atlanta Braves!
